title: Someone else's event opens as details; fields you may not change are dimmed in its edit form
steps: With -UseFakeData -UseFakeCalendar open Calendar (2) and click an afternoon meeting with Sam Rivera (someone else organizes it)
Read the card, then open ••• and choose Edit…
Look at each row: title, time, repeat and visibility are disabled; reminders, Busy or Free and colour still work
Hold the pointer over a dimmed row
expected: The card first shows the event's details with the Going? answers at the bottom, not a form. Edit… shows the form: rows you cannot change are dimmed and do nothing; no amber or lock sentence shows anywhere. Holding the pointer over a dimmed row shows why (for example that someone else organizes the event); VoiceOver reads the same. Decline is in the ••• menu instead of Delete.
